about: Read notes.md and tell me the release day. Don't run commands. / Without reading anything again, which day was it? Two turns from another client of the harness, whose record of the session is read while the session is still open there.

known.line: user: Read notes.md and tell me the release day. Don't run commands.
known.reason: Devin 3000.11.205 sends each prompt back to a client that groups messages (`cognition.ai/messageGrouping`, with a `cognition.ai/clientMessageId` on each prompt, as Devin.app does and as this pair's client does), so the pair's live drawing has each prompt twice: as sent, and as sent back. Its stores and Devin.app's journal hold it once. Mako's own client sends no message id and gets none back.
